votes.motion: Approve minutes from May 5, 2020 and January 12, 2021
votes.description: The Board approved the meeting minutes from the May 5, 2020 and January 12, 2021 RDA meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt and confirm RDA Resolution 3 of 2021, Adopting an Updated RDA Art Policy
votes.description: The Board confirmed adoption of a resolution updating the RDA Art Policy, changing the public art funding allocation from 1% to 1.5% of certain Agency construction project budgets and adding ongoing annual funding and incentives to promote art.

votes.motion: Adopt and confirm RDA Resolution 4 of 2021, Housing Allocation Funds Policy
votes.description: The Board confirmed adoption of a resolution establishing the RDA Housing Allocation Funds Policy, which provides guidelines for allocating funding and directing resources to develop and preserve housing in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Ratify the determination that the Board will continue to meet remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002
votes.description: The Board ratified the chair's determination to continue holding remote meetings without an anchor location as authorized under HB5002 during the ongoing emergency.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (Resolution: Amending the 9 Line Community Reinvestment Project Area Budget)
votes.description: The Board approved the consent agenda, which set March 23, 2021 as the date to accept public comment and potentially adopt a resolution amending the 9-Line project area budget based on interlocal agreements with participating taxing entities.
The Board voted to adjourn the February 9, 2021 RDA meeting.
